# Original source transcription notes

## Edition selection

S15–S17 are current original PDF text retrieved from the issuer’s published schedule URLs. S18–S19 are older indexed excerpts exposed before those original URLs were reopened. They are stored as different source classes with their actual coverage. The current data selects S15–S17; the older observations support only the fields actually visible in those excerpts.

The original [IAWAI schedule](<https://cabis.ianz.govt.nz/ianzwebportal/ViewScope.aspx?Program=b0cd4736-6581-4ec3-9088-07cf259032fe>) supplies issue 53, client 149, accreditation 791 and the current programme UUID. The older indexed issue 51 supplied the Hamilton City Council label. This is continuity of an issuer record; the public material does not supply an independent legal-party register.

The [MicroAquaTech source](<https://cabis.ianz.govt.nz/ianzwebportal/ViewScope.aspx?Program=b06f40dc-4251-4157-9579-6616beb58425>) prints the method’s superseded qualifier in issue 23. Preserve that text as part of the original method selection. The [MECNZ schedule](<https://cabis.ianz.govt.nz/ianzwebportal/ViewScope.aspx?Program=ca818460-aa11-432d-871b-c79da794cb64>) prints ISO/IEC 17020:2012 and Type A. The separate [May 2026 transition notice](<https://www.ianz.govt.nz/media/xy2cz2is/iso-iec-17020-2026-transition-notice.pdf>) is retained as a source-dated planning profile.

## Scope rows

`public-scope-items.csv` is a selected transcription of 24 publicly printed records. Each row retains its source and one-based page. The original complete schedule URL remains the source for its full scope and all surrounding conditions. Original method codes, element symbols, date precision and qualifiers are preserved.

## Fees

The [AS19 laboratory schedule](<https://www.ianz.govt.nz/media/bkjfhlun/as19-fee-schedule-drinking-water-laboratory.pdf>) and [AS14 inspection schedule](<https://www.ianz.govt.nz/media/gcompp0b/as14-fee-schedule-inspection-bodies.pdf>) are labelled July 2026 and published as 2026/27. Values are NZD exclusive of GST. `fee-rates.csv` stores rates and units separately; `fee-controls.json` identifies authored arithmetic choices explicitly. Source tariffs provide rate facts; actual invoice quantities, credits, taxes and finance-account relationships are received from the original financial cohort.

## Procedures and forms

The [AS1 edition](<https://www.ianz.govt.nz/media/ddub3rh4/as1-procedures-and-conditions-for-accreditation.pdf>) is September 2024. It supports the relationship between applications, document review, assessment, findings, issued decisions and scope. Programme-specific requirements and actual issued dates take precedence in the saved project. AS1 does not cover every programme in the 19-label navigation.

The six DOCX references are original currently linked forms. Their exact bodies, content controls and footer editions are being received through IANZ-A1. The supplied canonical model is authored engineering; a native form field is bound only when its original control or table field is received.

## Original bytes and portable assets

The register distinguishes a source URL, a transcription digest and an original byte digest. A completed original-file return adds its true byte count, SHA256 and portable asset path to that same source edition. This preserves the existing data and source comparisons as the original assets arrive.
